help: Add at least one category under the problem.
rationale: The diagram renders the problem head above a zero-length spine.

help: Add causes to the category, or remove it.
rationale: The bone draws at a fifth of its full length with nothing attached.

summary: ishikawa node is nested more than five levels deep
help: Flatten the branch, or split the diagram.
rationale: Deep nesting is a matter of taste, so this rule is off by default.

summary: two ishikawa nodes under one parent have identical text
help: Rename one of the nodes, or merge them.
rationale: The same cause renders twice, so the diagram doubles a reason that appears once.
